claim: Nobara ships a dedicated NVIDIA ISO with akmod-nvidia pre-configured.
Ubuntu 26.04 carries the official NVIDIA 595 driver, installable via ubuntu-drivers autoinstall.

claim: New Intel (Xe3P_LPG, Nova Lake) and AMD (DCN 4.2) GPU enablement lands per kernel release, so kernel recency governs support for new silicon.
quote: initial Xe3P_LPG and Nova Lake P enablement support in Linux 7.1

claim: Microsoft's UEFI CA 2011 certificate expired 27 June 2026; major distros ship dual-signed shims so Secure Boot can stay enabled; BitLocker recovery is triggered by boot/ESP changes.
quote: The Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011 certificate expires June 27, 2026, after which Microsoft will only sign new bootloaders with the 2023 replacement key.

claim: NVIDIA open kernel modules are default on Turing+ with proprietary userspace; Wayland fixed by driver 555 explicit sync; NVK usable but well behind; AMD dropped its proprietary stack.
quote: The 555 driver series introduced explicit sync support in June 2024, and the 570 series refined it throughout 2025.

claim: Ubuntu 26.04 targets better NVIDIA performance under its default GNOME Wayland session.
quote: the upcoming Ubuntu 26.04 LTS release will further enhance the NVIDIA graphics performance under its default GNOME Wayland session

claim: MediaTek MT7902 Wi-Fi 6E had no Linux driver until a mainline patchset targeting Linux 7.0.
quote: MediaTek MT7902 wireless modules are used in many Windows laptops, but so far, a Linux driver has been missing.

claim: MT7927 Wi-Fi 7 needs kernel 7.2+ (or a backporting distro kernel) and its Bluetooth firmware blob is still not in linux-firmware.
quote: the drivers are upstream, but one firmware file isn't

claim: Framework laptops show variable s2idle sleep drain — a firmware/kernel issue rather than a distro one.
